exposure: Maximum block height above T4 level
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Arrhythmia during cesarean section under spinal anesthesia was common (31.9% incidence), with sinus bradycardia being the most frequent type, and was associated with hypotension, higher block height, larger bupivacaine doses, and uterine manipulation, but did not adversely impact immediate neonatal outcomes.
